scope: Six native hosts compare raw interpretation with direct/ordinary integer output, ARC/stressed tracing and O0/O2. Tests cover integer widths, shared strings, trap order and binary-output routing. A separate test requires zero output String allocations versus one in the ordinary control and must reject an inserted allocation at both optimization levels and memory modes. Those counts are test assertions, not whole-process allocation or timing data. The 144 saved semantic-test binaries are inspected as data, never executed by this collector. ARC binaries must exclude tracing symbols. Tracing controls must contain them, except the direct O2 print-then-trap case, whose unused collector can be eliminated. Observed symbols are recorded in every case. Assembly needs human review for stack/register claims. WASI and full production acceptance are separate gates.
